target: 1998 Lexus LS400 UCF20, UK RHD facelift, 1UZ-FE VVT-i

evidence.review: Inspected the linked 508 x 149 GIF. It shows a modified car with aftermarket wheels and body kit; only a side view is present despite the page listing four views. Rejected for stock geometry and dimensional measurements.

Inspected public facelift preview: left/right side, front and rear. No top view, panel sections, survey tolerance or engine-bay dimensions in the preview. High-resolution vector advertised for $24; not purchased. Useful candidate for silhouette work, not manufacturer CAD or proof of 1:1 accuracy.
Product explicitly lists arbitrary scale. Not accepted as measured geometry; no purchase.

Inspected actual 44-second Walkaround player at 0:00, 0:23 and 0:33: stock-looking white US LHD facelift, silver lower cladding and five-opening wheels. Confirms rounded rear lamp ends, body contour and fuel flap. Use shared body observations only; do not transplant US wheels, lighting or brake installation into the UK target. No footage redistributed.
Manufacturer nominal envelope remains the dimensional reference. Overall dimensions do not determine local panel curvature or engine component clearances.
Existing UK RHD engine-bay photographs remain configuration-matched layout references; no surveyed dimensions or lens calibration.

requiredForValidatedReplica: Configuration-matched exterior scan or manufacturer surface CAD with a documented unit scale and rights to publish derived assets.
Measured engine-bay/part scans and reference datums; external walkaround footage cannot recover hidden components.
Calibrated multi-view photographs, camera information and scale targets if photogrammetry is used; reflective paint and glass require controlled capture.
Independent deviation checks against measured points and a declared tolerance; unit-test success is not real-car accuracy certification.
